architecture.mechanism: Full-scale fire experimentation to measure thermal hazards and heat flux data for vehicle fire dynamics.
architecture.intervention: Implement a manufacturer-authorized diagnostic protocol using heat flux sensors and gas temperature monitoring on the engine block and catalytic converter assembly to quantify thermal accumulation rates prior to failure, replacing subjective visual inspection.
architecture.expected_effect: Objective identification of abnormal thermal profiles leading to engine failure, providing verified data required for warranty coverage approval on the leased vehicle.
architecture.falsification_test: If the implemented sensor array records heat flux and gas temperature values within the standard baseline range during a simulated load test while the engine light flashes, the thermal failure hypothesis is rejected.
